about: Hand decisions about MHSP1 stat blocks and its Reference Summary, applied by scripts/msh/roster.py and scripts/msh/booklet.py after parsing. Every one was read off the page image; none is a guess from OCR.
Facts only - ranks, numbers and labels, never the book's prose - so this file is committed while roster.json stays in the local cache.
match     {page, header, kind?, label?}: a Roster Booklet block, as in ma1-overrides.json; kind 'line' is a one-line F A S E R I P grid
{summary}: a Reference Summary row (PDF 34), by the name the chart prints
verdict   as_printed        the page is unambiguous and the check still fails; kept as printed, and the note says why
label             the block has no printed name above it; 'label' names it from its entry's own text
summary_misprint  the chart prints a value its own ranks contradict and the Roster Booklet's block does not; 'printed' is the chart's, 'corrected' the block's
summary_blank     the chart prints a dash where the Roster Booklet prints a value
checked   the date the page image was read

overrides.note: Reason is printed as a question mark. Karma 40 = Intuition 20 + Psyche 20, so the book counts it as 0.

overrides.label: Sound creatures
overrides.note: The creatures Klaw makes with his sound powers; Health 72, no Karma printed.

overrides.label: Curtis Connors
overrides.note: The human form, named as the entry's identity line names him.

overrides.label: Marsha Rosenberg
overrides.note: The human form, named as the entry's identity line names her.
F 75 + A 75 + S 1000 + E 1000 = 2150, as the Roster Booklet prints (p.12).
R 4 + I 10 + P 30 = 44, as the Roster Booklet prints (p.13).
R 10 + I 4 + P 75 = 89, as the Roster Booklet prints (p.14).
The chart prints a dash; the Roster Booklet prints 40 (p.9).
